description: School briefing: profile, cancellation policy, reviews, image URLs, bookings_live flag, and optional hero image for chat UI. Requires school_id from search_language_schools.

include_hero_image.description: When true, structuredContent may include a compressed JPEG in MCP image content; hero_image is stripped from structuredContent after attach.

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

school_id.description: Craft CMS school entry id from search_language_schools hits (field school_id). Not the CRM UUID.

name: get_school

data.description: School profile (title, url, city, country, bookings_live, reviews, images[]).
